en: Color postcard-style image showing a peaceful riverside park scene. In the foreground, two women sit on a white bench facing a wide river, with a dog lying beside them and another woman in a yellow headscarf sitting on the grass. Birch trees frame the scene on both sides. Across the river are green fields and a cluster of mid‑20th‑century buildings, including a white multi‑story structure with a central tower and other low-rise residential or institutional buildings, surrounded by trees under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
